PLAN "12-Week Low-Impact Strength Program for Post-Meniscal Injury Return to Skiing"
TYPE workout
VISIBILITY public

GOALS
  GOAL primary strength:
    name "Increase lower and upper body strength with knee-protective, low-impact loading to facilitate return to skiing"

PHASES
  PHASE "Phase 1" (4 weeks):
    WEEK 1:
      DAY Monday training 45m "Foundation and stability":
        warmup:
          walking 5 minutes
        main straight_sets:
          goblet_squat 3x8..12 rpe 7 rest 90 seconds
          leg_curl 3x10..12 rpe 6 rest 60 seconds
          hip_thrust 3x8..12 rpe 7 rest 90 seconds
          barbell_row 3x8..12 rpe 7 rest 60 seconds
          incline_press 3x8..12 rpe 7 rest 60 seconds
          cable_row 3x8..12 rpe 7 rest 60 seconds
        cooldown:
          chest_stretch 60 seconds
          hamstring_stretch 60 seconds
    WEEK 2:
      DAY Monday training 45m "Stability and buildup":
        warmup:
          walking 5 minutes
        main straight_sets:
          goblet_squat 3x6..10 rpe 7 rest 90 seconds
          leg_extension 3x10..12 rpe 6 rest 60 seconds
          hip_thrust 3x8..12 rpe 7 rest 90 seconds
          dumbbell_row 3x8..12 rpe 7 rest 60 seconds
          bench_press 3x6..10 rpe 7 rest 60 seconds
          lat_pulldown 3x8..12 rpe 7 rest 60 seconds
        cooldown:
          shoulder_stretch 60 seconds
          quad_stretch 60 seconds
    WEEK 3:
      DAY Monday training 45m "Progress and control":
        warmup:
          walking 5 minutes
        main straight_sets:
          goblet_squat 3x8..12 rpe 7 rest 90 seconds
          leg_curl 3x10..12 rpe 6 rest 60 seconds
          hip_thrust 3x8..12 rpe 7 rest 90 seconds
          barbell_row 3x8..12 rpe 7 rest 60 seconds
          incline_press 3x8..12 rpe 7 rest 60 seconds
          cable_row 3x8..12 rpe 7 rest 60 seconds
        cooldown:
          hip_flexor_stretch 60 seconds
          calf_stretch 60 seconds
    WEEK 4:
      DAY Monday training 45m "Stability test and deload":
        warmup:
          walking 5 minutes
        main straight_sets:
          goblet_squat 2x8..12 rpe 6 rest 90 seconds
          leg_extension 2x10..12 rpe 6 rest 60 seconds
          hip_thrust 2x8..12 rpe 6 rest 90 seconds
          dumbbell_row 2x8..12 rpe 6 rest 60 seconds
          incline_press 2x8..12 rpe 6 rest 60 seconds
          lat_pulldown 2x8..12 rpe 6 rest 60 seconds
        cooldown:
          spinal_twist 60 seconds
          hamstring_stretch 60 seconds

  PHASE "Phase 2" (4 weeks):
    WEEK 5:
      DAY Monday training 50m "Load introduction":
        warmup:
          cycling 5 minutes
        main straight_sets:
          goblet_squat 4x6..10 rpe 7 rest 90 seconds
          leg_curl 3x10..12 rpe 6 rest 60 seconds
          hip_thrust 4x6..10 rpe 7 rest 90 seconds
          romanian_deadlift 3x6..10 rpe 7 rest 90 seconds
          dumbbell_row 3x8..12 rpe 7 rest 60 seconds
          incline_press 3x6..10 rpe 7 rest 60 seconds
        cooldown:
          hip_flexor_stretch 60 seconds
          calf_stretch 60 seconds
    WEEK 6:
      DAY Monday training 50m "Grip, core, and posterior chain focus":
        warmup:
          cycling 5 minutes
        main straight_sets:
          goblet_squat 4x6..10 rpe 7 rest 90 seconds
          leg_curl 3x10..12 rpe 6 rest 60 seconds
          hip_thrust 4x6..10 rpe 7 rest 90 seconds
          cable_row 3x8..12 rpe 7 rest 60 seconds
          lat_pulldown 3x8..12 rpe 7 rest 60 seconds
          planks 3x30 seconds rpe 4 rest 60 seconds
        cooldown:
          thoracic_rotation 60 seconds
    WEEK 7:
      DAY Monday training 50m "Volume buildup":
        warmup:
          cycling 5 minutes
        main straight_sets:
          goblet_squat 4x8..12 rpe 7 rest 90 seconds
          leg_extension 3x10..12 rpe 6 rest 60 seconds
          hip_thrust 4x8..12 rpe 7 rest 90 seconds
          barbell_row 3x8..12 rpe 7 rest 60 seconds
          incline_press 3x8..12 rpe 7 rest 60 seconds
          cable_row 3x8..12 rpe 7 rest 60 seconds
        cooldown:
          hip_stretch 60 seconds
    WEEK 8:
      DAY Monday training 50m "Deload and technique":
        warmup:
          cycling 5 minutes
        main straight_sets:
          goblet_squat 3x6..10 rpe 6 rest 90 seconds
          leg_curl 3x10..12 rpe 6 rest 60 seconds
          hip_thrust 3x6..10 rpe 6 rest 90 seconds
          dumbbell_row 3x8..12 rpe 6 rest 60 seconds
          incline_press 3x6..10 rpe 6 rest 60 seconds
          lat_pulldown 3x8..12 rpe 6 rest 60 seconds
        cooldown:
          mobility_sequence 5 minutes

  PHASE "Phase 3" (4 weeks):
    WEEK 9:
      DAY Monday training 55m "Strength peak early":
        warmup:
          cycling 5 minutes
        main straight_sets:
          goblet_squat 4x6..10 rpe 8 rest 90 seconds
          leg_press 3x8..12 rpe 7 rest 90 seconds
          hip_thrust 4x6..10 rpe 8 rest 90 seconds
          romanian_deadlift 4x6..10 rpe 8 rest 90 seconds
          barbell_row 3x6..10 rpe 8 rest 60 seconds
          bench_press 3x6..10 rpe 8 rest 60 seconds
        cooldown:
          hip_flexor_stretch 60 seconds
    WEEK 10:
      DAY Monday training 55m "Controlled overload":
        warmup:
          cycling 5 minutes
        main straight_sets:
          goblet_squat 4x6..10 rpe 8 rest 90 seconds
          leg_press 3x8..12 rpe 7 rest 90 seconds
          hip_thrust 4x6..10 rpe 8 rest 90 seconds
          dumbbell_row 3x8..12 rpe 7 rest 60 seconds
          incline_press 3x6..10 rpe 8 rest 60 seconds
          lat_pulldown 3x8..12 rpe 7 rest 60 seconds
        cooldown:
          thoracic_extension 60 seconds
    WEEK 11:
      DAY Monday training 55m "Power-ish with controlled tempo":
        warmup:
          cycling 5 minutes
        main straight_sets:
          goblet_squat 4x6..8 rpe 8 rest 90 seconds
          leg_curl 3x10..12 rpe 6 rest 60 seconds
          hip_thrust 4x6..10 rpe 8 rest 90 seconds
          barbell_row 3x6..10 rpe 8 rest 60 seconds
          incline_press 3x6..10 rpe 8 rest 60 seconds
          cable_row 3x8..12 rpe 7 rest 60 seconds
        cooldown:
          calf_stretch 60 seconds
    WEEK 12:
      DAY Monday training 55m "Ramp to skiing readiness":
        warmup:
          cycling 5 minutes
        main straight_sets:
          goblet_squat 3x8..12 rpe 7 rest 90 seconds
          leg_curl 3x10..12 rpe 6 rest 60 seconds
          hip_thrust 3x8..12 rpe 7 rest 90 seconds
          romanian_deadlift 3x6..10 rpe 7 rest 90 seconds
          dumbbell_row 3x8..12 rpe 7 rest 60 seconds
          incline_press 3x8..12 rpe 7 rest 60 seconds
        cooldown:
          mobility_sequence 5 minutes

Notes for the trainer:
- This plan emphasizes low-impact, knee-friendly loading without jump movements or deep knee flexion under load.
- Substitutions: if any exercise becomes intolerable, swap with a safe alternative of the same category (e.g., replace goblet_squat with leg_press or front_squat if knee tolerance allows; ensure load remains controlled and non-derailing to knee).
- Progression is conservative in Phase 1 to protect the meniscus; Phase 2 introduces moderate increases in volume and load; Phase 3 targets strength peak with maintained knee safety.
- Ski-specific transfer will be addressed in cooldown/mobility blocks and targeted core stability; assess ski-specific readiness at end of Phase 3.
